subject: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR TUESDAY, JUNE 9, 2026
plaintextBody:
City Seal 170

June 8, 2026 

*FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY*   

*CONTACT:* pressoffice@cityhall.nyc.gov    

   

*PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI*   

*FOR TUESDAY, JUNE 9, 2026* 

   

"On Tuesday, Mayor Mamdani will hold an ethnic and community media roundtable focused on 2-K enrollment. On-site attendance at this event will be available to invited press only. This event will be livestreamed. "  

 

"Then, the Mayor will attend the ""New York City Police Department's"" (NYPD) Medal Day Ceremony. This event is open to press." 

 

"After, the Mayor will distribute informational materials with Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) Commissioner Sam Levine and members of the City Council. This event will be pooled by NYC Media and distributed after the stop." 

 

"Later, the Mayor will host a Pride event. This event is open to press." 

 

_*Press Schedule*:_" "

"On-site attendance at this event will be available to invited press only."
